answer: Echo-Taxed Island Liquidity (ETIL): identities are free, but each starts on an isolated low-impact “island” whose market influence scales with log(1+useful trade surplus). Pooling influence across identities triggers a cross-island echo tax: fee = c·(1+k)^β·s, where k is linked identities and s is behavioral similarity, β>1. Honest agents converge in a repeated-trade “haven” with low tax. A sybil fleet’s marginal cost rises superlinearly per identity.
